query: I ordered a $68 plant and a $10 pot. Do I get free shipping?
reference_answer: Yes. Total is $78, which is over the $75 threshold, so Standard shipping is free (after discounts, before tax).

query: My order is $80 but I have a $10 promo code. Will shipping still be free?
reference_answer: No. Free Standard shipping requires $75+ after discounts; $70 after the code means $7.95 Standard shipping applies.

query: I placed an order 3 hours ago and want to cancel. Can I do it in My Orders?
reference_answer: No, the free online change/cancel window is 2 hours. Support can try to intercept it before it ships, but that isn't guaranteed.

query: I ordered a plant on Wednesday at 3pm. When will it ship?
reference_answer: Live plants ship Mon–Wed, and orders after 12 noon Wednesday ship the next Monday.

query: I live 1,200 miles from your greenhouse. Can I get express shipping on a plant?
reference_answer: No. Over 1,000 miles is Zone 3, where Express isn't available. Standard takes 5–8 business days.

query: I'm a Leafy Plus member. Can I get free Express shipping on my order?
reference_answer: No. Plus gives free Standard shipping with no minimum, but Express is $14.95 and never free.

query: I want an XL 5 ft fiddle leaf fig with Express shipping. How much extra will that cost?
reference_answer: XL plants ship Standard only, so Express isn't possible. XL adds a $20 handling fee.

query: I bought a bag of soil 10 days ago, opened it, and changed my mind. Can I return it?
reference_answer: No. Opened soil can't be returned unless it's faulty, even within the 30-day window.

query: I got a ceramic pot 25 days ago and don't like the color. It's unused and in the box. What will the return cost me?
reference_answer: It's within 30 days, so it's returnable. Change-of-mind returns cost a flat $6.95 deducted from the refund (free for Leafy Plus members).

query: I got my return label 9 days ago and haven't dropped off the parcel yet. Is it still OK?
reference_answer: No. Labels expire after 7 days. Start a new return from My Orders if still within the 30-day window.

query: My monstera arrived 3 days ago with a snapped main stem. Can I get a replacement?
reference_answer: DOA must be reported within 48 hours of delivery. At 3 days, it goes through the Plant Care Guarantee, with photos, within 30 days, reviewed in 2 business days.

query: My plant was delivered yesterday and the pot is cracked and the roots are exposed. What do I do?
reference_answer: Report it within 48 hours with photos of the plant and box. You get a free replacement on the next plant shipping day or a refund.

query: A $30 glass pot arrived smashed. Do I have to send it back?
reference_answer: Report within 48 hours with photos. Replacement or refund; items under $40 usually don't need to be sent back.

query: You sent me a pothos but I ordered a peperomia. Can I keep it, and when do I get the right one?
reference_answer: A wrong live plant can be kept at no charge. The correct item ships free by Express where the zone allows.

query: My plant was delivered 35 days ago and is now dying. Can I claim under the guarantee?
reference_answer: Not on a standard 30-day guarantee. If you're a Leafy Plus member and the plant was ordered while active, the guarantee is 90 days.

query: I'm Leafy Plus and my plant arrived 60 days ago and now has root rot. Am I covered?
reference_answer: Yes, if the plant was ordered while the membership was active, since the guarantee is 90 days. Submit a claim in My Orders with two photos.

query: One older leaf on my new calathea turned yellow after 5 days. Can I get a replacement?
reference_answer: Probably not. Yellowing of one or two older leaves in the first two weeks is normal transplant stress and not covered on its own.

query: I repotted my plant into other soil on day 7 and it died on day 20. Will you replace it?
reference_answer: Not covered: repotting into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days is excluded. Escalation might be possible if you insist.

query: My replacement plant died too after 20 days. Will you replace it again?
reference_answer: Yes. A replacement has its own new 30-day guarantee, so it can be replaced once more. That second replacement has no guarantee.

query: What do I need to include in a plant guarantee claim and how long until I hear back?
reference_answer: Claim from My Orders with at least two photos (whole plant and close-up). A specialist reviews within 2 business days. The plant doesn't need to be returned.

query: A weather hold was emailed to me and I waived it. My plant arrived frozen. Can I claim?
reference_answer: No. Cold or heat damage in transit isn't covered once the hold is waived, and DOA claims for it aren't accepted.

query: My tracking hasn't moved in 5 business days. What happens now?
reference_answer: Contact support: the 4-business-day threshold is met. We open a courier investigation of up to 5 business days. If lost, you choose a free replacement or full refund.

query: Item out of stock after I ordered. I didn't reply to your email for 3 days. What happened?
reference_answer: With no reply within 3 days, the item is automatically refunded.

query: I canceled an order an hour after placing it but my bank still shows a charge. Is that a double charge?
reference_answer: Likely a pending authorisation, which drops off in 3–7 business days depending on the bank. Leafy can't release it faster.

query: I see two charges for order LF-204518 and both have posted. What do you need from me?
reference_answer: Send the order number and last four card digits only (never full number, CVV or password). The duplicate is refunded within 3 business days of confirmation. Suspected disputes may be escalated.

query: My card was replaced after my refund was issued. Can you send it to my new card?
reference_answer: No. Refunds go only to the original payment method; the bank normally passes it to the replacement card. Store credit is an instant alternative.

query: How long will a refund take if I paid with a digital wallet versus a card?
reference_answer: Digital wallets take 3–5 business days; cards take 5–10 business days, once issued. Store credit is instant.

query: I returned a pot and it reached your warehouse Monday. When will I get my refund?
reference_answer: Refunds are issued within 5 business days of arrival, then card timing of 5–10 business days (3–5 for wallets) applies.

query: I bought a $40 plant 5 days ago and it's now $32. Can I get the difference?
reference_answer: Yes, within 7 days: $8 as store credit, once per item, unless it was a flash sale or clearance item.

query: Can I use a promo code and my Leafy Plus discount on the same pot?
reference_answer: No. They can't be combined on the same item; the better discount applies automatically. Only one promo code per order.

query: I forgot my promo code. Can I add it to my order from this morning?
reference_answer: No. Promo codes can't be added after ordering.

query: Can I use buy-now-pay-later on a $40 order? What about $600?
reference_answer: BNPL is available on orders of $50–$1,000, so not $40 but yes for $600.

query: I have a Collector plan and want to cancel today, the 26th. Will I be charged next month?
reference_answer: Changes on or after the 25th apply to the following month's box. The already-billed box ($49) is not refunded and is still sent. There's no cancellation fee.

query: If I switch from Starter to Collector on the 20th, which box is affected?
reference_answer: Changes before the 25th affect the next box, so next month's box will be Collector at $49.

query: What's the longest I can pause Plant Club and where do I do it?
reference_answer: Up to 3 months, from Account > Subscriptions.

query: I bought Leafy Plus 10 days ago and used free shipping once. Can I get a refund?
reference_answer: No. A full refund needs cancellation within 14 days and no benefits used. Benefits continue to the end of the paid year.

query: I bought Leafy Plus 5 days ago and haven't used anything. Can I get my $59 back?
reference_answer: Yes, a full refund if cancelled within 14 days with no benefits used.

query: I have a cat. Is a ZZ plant OK, or should I get a spider plant?
reference_answer: ZZ plant is not pet-safe; spider plant is pet-safe.

query: My dog just chewed a pothos leaf. What should I do?
reference_answer: Contact your vet or local poison control immediately. We will then escalate to a human Support Lead.

query: I want a $200 refund for a damaged order and I'm really upset. Who handles this?
reference_answer: A refund over $150 requires escalation to a human Support Lead. We'll escalate.

query: My delivery was late. Can you give me a $25 credit as an apology?
reference_answer: Agents can offer one-time goodwill store credit up to $15; more needs a Support Lead. Goodwill is never cash.

query: What are your chat hours, and can I call someone on Sunday?
reference_answer: Chat is 8am–8pm Mon–Sat. There's no phone support. Email help@leafy.example is answered within 1 business day.

query: I'm trying to reach a plant specialist on Saturday at 10am. Are they available?
reference_answer: No. Plant Care Specialists chat 9am–5pm Mon–Fri. Email is an option, or the general chat is open Saturday.

query: Can you change the email on my account? I'm in chat right now.
reference_answer: Support can't change an account email over chat. Log in and change it yourself.

query: I think someone logged into my account and placed an order. What now?
reference_answer: Reset your password immediately; support escalates the possible unauthorised access.

query: I'm 17 and want to open an account to buy succulents. Is that fine?
reference_answer: No. Customers must be 18 or older to hold an account.

query: I want a plant delivered to my PO box with a $20 pot.
reference_answer: Live plants can't ship to PO boxes; only non-living items can. The pot alone could go there.

query: My gift card code is lost. How can I get it back, and can I cash it out instead?
reference_answer: The purchaser can give the gift card order number to have it reissued. Gift cards are not refundable for cash.

query: I ordered a gift and want to write a 250-character note. Will the price be on the slip?
reference_answer: Gift notes are up to 200 characters, so it needs shortening. Prices are never printed on gift packing slips.

query: I ordered the wrong address and it already shipped. Can you redirect the courier?
reference_answer: No. The address can't be changed after shipping and couriers don't accept redirection requests from Leafy.

query: This is the third time I've asked about my missing refund and nobody fixed it. Also can you ship internationally to my sister in Canada?
reference_answer: The same issue raised three or more times is escalated to a Support Lead. There's no international shipping.
